zombies.skeptic_notes: The original was closed by a crew at creation ('Internal Case Performed by Highway Maintenance crew'), and the re-report is another staff-entered case (Employee Generated) opened about 1 minute later at 0 m. This is how a crew logs several defects fixed in one visit, one case each; it is not evidence that the first pothole came back. Both cases carry identical coordinates, which means both were geocoded to the same address point; where the pothole sits along that frontage is not recorded.
